title: Worship & Sacrifice
reason: None of the items are mark-affecting; stating that Roman sacrifices had to be restarted from scratch if a mistake was made is the standard school-level simplification of Roman ritual precision and is fully credited in GCSE mark schemes.

pedantry.quote: It all comes down to the principle of piacula, or atonement.
The principle of atonement meant an entire sacrifice restarted for one mistake.
